name: dispatch_requester_input_events
description: Loops over the requester state block, testing an event flag word and dispatching each input event. Each branch calls library routines through the library's function table, and the state fields are then copied into the block.

name: resume_requester_input_dispatch
description: Re-enters the same flag-testing dispatch loop after one library call, so it continues processing input events from the requester state block.

name: allocate_named_requester_entry
description: Compares two name strings and, when they differ, allocates a memory block and copies a 356-byte entry record from the caller's data into it.

name: build_requester_entry_defaults
description: Allocates a memory block, copies the caller's 356-byte entry record into it, and replaces zero values in two short-value tables with the defaults 1 and 3.

name: initialise_requester_entry_fields
description: Allocates a memory block and fills a requester entry record from the caller's data, copying its field tables and setting its header pointers.

name: free_requester_entry_resources
description: Calls the library cleanup routine when an entry pointer is set, then frees the memory block held in a second field. It also copies the entry's name and title strings and some size values into the record.

name: configure_file_requester_gadgets
description: Copies the requester's title and text strings into its record and sets gadget positions and sizes from a field table. The strings it works with include the labels 'File requester', 'Leave', 'Parent' and 'Toggle .info'.

name: update_requester_state_fields
description: Copies the selected entry's name into its text field when a pointer is set, then calls library routines and copies state values from the entry table into the requester header.

name: release_requester_entry_state
description: Clears the entry's active flag, calls library routines, and copies the entry's state fields into its header. It then frees a memory block through the exec free call.

name: copy_entry_strings_to_buffers
description: Copies two name strings from the entry into the buffers it points to, then copies a 356-byte record into a second buffer and frees memory through the exec free call.

name: get_process_window_pointer
description: Finds the current task with the exec FindTask call. When it is a process with a window pointer, it stores that pointer and a status value in the caller's block, and otherwise stores a default status value.

name: copy_entry_status_value
description: Stores the status value 15 in a field of the caller's block and copies a value from a fixed offset of the entry into a second field.

name: call_requester_library_hook
description: Calls a library function through its function-table entry, using a pointer taken from the caller's block.

name: initialise_requester_layout_block
description: Initialises a fixed-layout block by setting its size, position and flag fields, storing the caller's text pointer, and linking the block into the caller's pointer slot.

name: copy_flag_byte_to_entry
description: Calls a routine, then copies one byte flag from the requester state block into a fixed offset of the entry.

name: copy_flag_bytes_to_entry
description: Calls a routine, then copies two byte values from the requester state block into two fixed offsets of the entry.

name: clear_stack_buffer_bytes
description: Zeroes a 14-byte local buffer on the stack and then calls another library routine.

name: open_copy_palette_window
description: Allocates a requester block, opens a font and an Intuition window, and sets up gadget records for the 'Copy' and 'Palette' labels, filling in their positions, sizes and flags.

name: poll_requester_input_for_doubleclick
description: Copies a name string into two buffers, then loops reading 26-word input event records through library calls. It uses the Intuition DoubleClick call to detect double clicks and dispatches the events to the requester's handlers.

name: dispatch_input_flags_and_cleanup
description: Tests input flag bits and dispatches matching events to handlers that read records through library calls. When the loop ends, it releases the requester's pointers through library calls.

name: dispatch_input_flags_loop
description: Tests input flag bits 32 and 1024 and runs the matching handler. It then reads and processes input event records in a loop through library calls.

name: poll_input_events_until_done
description: Repeatedly reads input event records through library calls while the 1024 flag is set. Matching events are passed to a handler that calls another library routine.

name: read_requester_input_events
description: Reads 26-word input event records through library calls in a loop, stores each one in the requester block and checks its flag word to choose the next action.

name: close_requester_font_and_window
description: Closes the requester's window and font through the Intuition and graphics close calls when their pointers are set. It then releases the requester block through a library call.

name: check_requester_flag_and_call
description: Tests bit 128 of a flag word in the requester block. When the bit is clear, it calls a library routine and another routine, then returns 0.

name: dispatch_keyed_handler_table
description: Scans a table of 16-bit keys, terminated by a negative value, for the key passed in the data register. On a match it calls the handler address stored after that key.

name: call_pointer_from_block
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in the first longword of the argument block.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns; the routine consists of a single return instruction.

name: call_load_palette_wrapper
description: Calls the LoadRGB4 wrapper routine that loads a colour palette through graphics, then returns the value -1 to the caller.

name: stub_return_negative_one
description: Does no work and returns the value -1 to its caller.

name: call_and_return_zero
description: Calls another routine and then returns the value 0.

name: call_and_return_zero
description: Calls another routine and then returns the value 0.

name: call_and_return_zero
description: Calls another routine and then returns the value 0.

name: call_and_return_zero
description: Calls another routine and then returns the value 0.

name: load_palette_and_return_zero
description: Calls the LoadRGB4 palette wrapper and one other routine, then returns 0.

name: select_requester_mode_code
description: Reads a mode code from the entry. Code 7 returns -1, and code 8 makes two calls and returns -1. Any other code, after two calls for code 6, is stored in a state field and the routine returns 0.

name: store_requester_mode_value_checked
description: Takes a mode value. Value 8 makes two calls and returns -1, and value 6 makes two calls and uses their result. Otherwise the value is stored in a state field and the routine returns 0.

name: store_requester_mode_value
description: Stores a mode value in a state field and returns 0. Mode 6 makes two calls first and stores their result instead.

name: update_palette_entry_loop
description: Loops over a colour entry, recomputes a 4-bit value from its stored colour, and when the value has changed updates it through the graphics SetRGB4 call. Each pass also waits for the vertical blank with WaitTOF.

name: compute_scaled_position_in_region
description: Checks that a stored state value equals 104 and that a coordinate lies within a fixed range. When it does, it computes a scaled position from table lookups and calls routines that update the requester's position.

name: read_palette_colour_mode_four
description: When the argument is 4, it reads two colour values through the GetRGB4 wrapper and stores them in state fields. In every case it clears a further state field.

name: step_palette_between_values
description: Loops from one value to another one unit at a time. On each step it calls three internal routines and the graphics SetRGB4 call, then clears a state field.

name: set_palette_colours_in_loop
description: Repeats a counted loop that calls three internal routines and the graphics SetRGB4 call on each pass, then clears a state field.

name: stub_return_negative_one
description: Does no work and returns the value -1 to its caller.

name: interpolate_colour_nibble
description: Computes one 4-bit colour component by interpolating between two colour values over a step count, then stores the result in the table entry before the target pointer.

name: store_interpolated_value_step
description: Computes half of a scaled difference, adds a base value to it, and stores the result in the table entry before the target pointer.

name: set_palette_colour_wrapper
description: Passes its arguments to the graphics SetRGB4 call through the library function table and returns the registers unchanged.

name: fill_rectangle_with_pen
description: Sets the drawing pen with the graphics SetAPen call, then fills a rectangle with the RectFill call using the coordinates passed in.

name: update_when_index_changes
description: If two index values differ, calls up to four internal routines. One of them runs only when the first index value is non-negative.

name: draw_text_at_position
description: Sets the drawing pen and draw mode through the graphics library, moves the pen, and draws text with the graphics Text call.

name: read_shifted_value_until_zero
description: Calls an internal routine repeatedly until its second result is zero, then returns the last value read shifted right by four bits.

name: store_gadget_colour_nibble
description: Stores the low four bits of its argument in a field, expands them into a 16-bit colour value by repeating the nibble, and stores that in a second field. It then calls an Intuition routine.

name: draw_with_temporary_flag
description: Sets the graphics draw mode and sets one bit of an object's flag byte. It calls a library routine twice, then restores the saved flag byte and draw mode.

name: copy_word_table_to_buffer
description: Copies a count of 16-bit words from a source table in the requester block into a destination buffer, looping until the count runs out.

name: copy_byte_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from the source pointer to the destination pointer, with the count taken from the data register.

name: draw_grid_of_indexed_cells
description: Loops over the rows and columns of a grid, calling two library routines for each cell and passing an incrementing cell index to the second one. The grid size is read from a table in the requester block.

name: draw_row_of_indexed_cells
description: Loops over rows, and for each row calls two library routines per cell, passing an incrementing cell index to the second. The count per row is read from a table in the requester block.

name: draw_cells_from_count_table
description: Walks a table of run lengths and calls two library routines for each cell with an incrementing index. It returns when the table is used up.

name: multiply_32bit_into_64bit
description: Stores one longword from an indexed table entry at the target location, then multiplies two 32-bit values from the data registers into a 64-bit result.

name: multiply_two_32bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from the data registers into a 64-bit result, returned in a pair of registers.

name: round_combined_result_words
description: Calls an internal routine that returns a 32-bit value, combines its words into a new 32-bit result, and adds one when the low word is negative.

name: divide_32bit_by_16bit
description: Divides a 32-bit value by the low word of the second argument and returns the 16-bit quotient halves packed together.

name: walk_line_with_callback
description: Steps along a line segment using an error term, and at each step calls a callback stored in the caller's record with the computed coordinates. Internal routines supply the intermediate values.

name: walk_line_with_offset_callback
description: Walks a line segment in the same stepping pattern as its neighbour, calling a callback stored at a different offset in the caller's record with the computed coordinates.

name: walk_line_with_vblank_wait
description: Walks a line segment in steps, calling a callback stored in the caller's record with each step's coordinates, and waits for the vertical blank with WaitTOF between steps.

name: match_name_against_pattern
description: Matches a text string against an AmigaDOS-style wildcard pattern using the hash, question-mark and star tokens, ignoring letter case, and returns a status value from the result.

name: match_pattern_with_star_skip
description: Matches a string against a wildcard pattern that contains a star, which lets the match skip ahead and retry from later positions. It ignores letter case and handles the hash and question-mark tokens as its neighbours do.

name: match_pattern_segment_to_query
description: Matches text against a wildcard pattern up to its question-mark token, comparing letters without regard to case, and returns a status value.

name: match_pattern_query_terminated
description: Matches text against a wildcard pattern that ends at a question-mark token, comparing letters without regard to case, and returns a status value from the result.

name: stub_return_true
description: Does no work and returns the value 1 to its caller.

name: test_string_is_empty
description: Returns a flag that is set when the string argument's first character is a zero byte, meaning the string is empty.

name: walk_pipe_separated_items
description: Walks a string whose items are separated by vertical bar characters, calls an internal routine for each item, and returns a status value showing whether the walk reached the end of the string.

name: stub_return_true
description: Does no work and returns the value 1 to its caller.

name: stub_return_stack_argument
description: Does no other work and returns the value passed to it on the stack unchanged.

name: open_and_dispatch_slot_request
description: Opens the exec library on first use, matches the caller's name against a table of named entries, and checks that the slot number lies in the entry's range. It clears the slots after that index, then calls the matched entry's handler. It returns error code 14 if the library cannot be opened, 17 for an out-of-range slot and 1 when no entry matches.

name: dispatch_slot_request_by_name
description: Matches the caller's name against a table of named entries, checks the slot number against the entry's range, clears the slots after it, and calls the matched entry's handler.

name: dispatch_slot_request_tail
description: Checks that the slot number lies in the matched entry's range, clears the slots after it, and calls the entry's handler. It returns error code 17 for an out-of-range slot and 1 when no entry matches.

name: clear_slots_and_call_handler
description: Clears the remaining slots of the request block from the current index up to sixteen, then calls the matched entry's handler and returns its result.

name: call_matched_entry_handler
description: Calls the handler stored in the matched entry and returns its result.

name: stub_return_true
description: Does no work and returns the value 1 to its caller.

name: set_palette_and_refresh
description: Calls the palette-set library routine and then a second library routine in sequence, using the library base held in the argument.

name: set_palette_refresh_with_constant
description: Stores a constant longword in a local slot, then calls the palette-set library routine and a second library routine.

name: build_requester_text_and_layout
description: Clears a 46-byte local buffer and fills in the requester's text and position fields from the caller's record. Empty text fields fall back to a default string, and a internal routine is called to build the requester.

name: show_okay_query_requester
description: Sets up a requester with the 'okay?' prompt text and layout values from the requester record. It then calls the requester routines to display it, returning error code 47 if a internal routine fails.

name: show_cancel_requester
description: Sets up a requester with the 'Cancel' label in its button fields and layout values from the record, then calls the requester routines to display it.

name: show_resume_requester
description: Sets up a requester with a 'Resume' label, builds it through the requester routines and stores the returned value in the caller's result slot.

name: show_okay_button_requester
description: Sets up a requester with an 'Okay' label, builds it through the requester routines and stores the returned value in the caller's result slot.

name: show_requester_without_label
description: Sets up a requester from the layout values in its record with no label text, builds it through the requester routines and stores the returned value in the caller's result slot.

name: stub_return_error_code
description: Does no work and returns the fixed error code 47 to its caller.

name: build_requester_and_store_result
description: Calls two requester routines in order, the second producing a result that is stored through the caller's result pointer. It returns 0.

name: run_requester_if_ready
description: Runs the requester routines when a field in the record is zero or a check passes, and stores the result through the caller's pointer. Otherwise it returns error code 47.

name: release_then_build_requester
description: Calls a requester library routine, then calls the requester build routine and stores its result through the caller's pointer. It returns 0.

name: store_requester_result
description: Calls the requester build routine and stores its result through the caller's pointer, then returns 0.

name: build_requester_with_flags
description: Clears a 34-byte local buffer, sets flag bits from the record, and checks the requester state through a library call. It then builds the requester and stores the result, or returns error code 47 when a check fails.

name: build_requester_flagged_result
description: Sets a flag bit when a record field is empty, checks the requester state through a library call, then builds the requester and stores the result through the caller's pointer.

name: build_requester_with_flag_set
description: Sets a flag bit in a local block and checks the requester state through a library call. It then either builds the requester or calls another routine, storing the result through the caller's pointer.

name: store_result_return_zero
description: Calls an internal routine, stores its result through the caller's pointer, and returns 0.

name: allocate_and_copy_requester_text
description: Measures the requester's text string, allocates a memory block for it, and copies the text into the block. It stores the block through the caller's pointer and returns error code 3 when allocation fails.

name: allocate_requester_block_with_minimums
description: Clears a 34-byte local block, raises two size values to minimums of 255 and 40 when they are too small, and allocates a memory block for the requester. It returns error code 3 if allocation fails.

name: allocate_requester_buffer_with_text
description: Allocates a memory block for the requester and copies its text into the block when a length is given. It fills in the block's fields through internal routines and returns error code 3 if allocation fails.

name: copy_text_buffer_and_free
description: Copies the requester text into an existing buffer when a length is given and fills in its fields. It then builds the requester, stores the result, and frees the buffer, returning error code 47 when a check fails.

name: build_requester_in_temp_buffer
description: Raises a size field to 40 when it is too small, allocates a temporary memory block, and builds the requester into it. It stores the result through the caller's pointer, frees the block, and returns 0.

name: free_requester_buffer_and_store
description: Calls an internal routine and stores its result through the caller's pointer. It then frees the memory block through the exec free call and returns 0.

name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Parses an optional plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a string, stores the value through the caller's pointer, and returns the number of characters consumed.

name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Parses an optional plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a string, stores the value through the caller's pointer, and returns the number of characters consumed.

name: store_signed_value_from_string
description: Stores a value through the caller's pointer, negating it when the string begins with a minus sign, and returns the number of characters consumed.

name: open_system_libraries_at_startup
description: Program entry code that opens the dos, graphics and intuition libraries by name through the exec library, and initialises drawing and timing calls. It then calls the routine that finds the largest value in a list of entries.

name: show_cancel_alert_and_cleanup
description: Code decoded from a gap in the program file, so parts of it may be data. It clears a 32-entry block, sets internal pointers, and shows an Intuition AutoRequest with the text 'Cancel' before closing a library and replying to messages.

name: copy_names_and_close_libraries
description: Copies two name strings and a data block from the program's state into local buffers, then clears two state fields and closes a library through the exec CloseLibrary call. It also calls internal routiness that find the largest value and free memory.

name: initialise_task_state_block
description: Clears a 32-entry block, sets internal pointers to it, and calls an internal routine before continuing with the exec FindTask call and system routines.

name: clear_block_and_write_newline
description: Clears a 32-entry block, sets internal pointers and calls a library routine. When a text buffer is set and a flag is clear, it appends a newline character to the text.

name: branch_on_word_and_call
description: Compares a 16-bit field with 37 and calls one of two exec library routines through the global library base, depending on the result. It then returns its two input registers.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls the exec AllocMem routine through the global library base, passing its arguments on unchanged.

name: walk_byte_table_update_pointers
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte table. A value of 1 advances the pointer by a fixed step, and any other value moves the pointer by twice that byte and adds the base address to the longword stored there.

name: clear_field_and_call_library
description: Clears a longword field in the program state and then calls a library routine through a pointer stored in that state.

name: process_descriptor_and_chain
description: Reads a descriptor structure and, depending on the sign of its short value, writes a table entry or copies its fields. For a negative value it chains a loop of pointers according to a count, frees memory through a library call, and adjusts two counters.

name: find_tagged_entry_and_copy
description: Decoded from a gap in the program file, so parts may be data. It finds a list entry by index and checks a four-byte tag, then copies data through the CopyMem stub or allocates it through a library call.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Decoded from a gap in the program file. It does nothing and returns, consisting of a single return instruction.

name: close_libraries_and_release_entries
description: Cleans up on exit. When flags are set it writes a newline-terminated string through a library call, closes two libraries through exec CloseLibrary, and processes each non-empty pair in a table of 23 entries.

name: check_table_entry_and_prepare
description: Looks up a table entry by index and checks a four-byte tag. A matching tag leads to a library call, and the entry's values are then prepared as results for the caller.

name: free_block_and_clear_counters
description: Calls the FreeMem stub, then clears two longword counters in the stack frame and returns the input data register unchanged.

name: signal_task_on_switcher
description: Calls the exec FindTask routine and, when a task is found, sends it a signal through the exec Signal call. The routine is tied to a text reference containing the word Switcher.

name: decode_packed_back_references
description: Part of a bit-packed decompressor. It reads control bits, then either writes literal bytes or copies a run of bytes from earlier in the output buffer, working backward from the destination pointer.

name: decompress_bitstream
description: Main routine of a packed bitstream decompressor. It reads control bits through the bit-reader internal routines, copies runs from earlier output or writes literal bytes, and stops when the destination pointer reaches its limit or the repeat count runs out.

name: boot_block_init_hardware
description: Boot block entry point, called by the Kickstart strap. It saves registers, allocates memory, runs a routine in supervisor mode, and programs the interrupt, DMA and copper pointer registers.

name: reset_then_call_program_entry
description: Calls the reset routine and then jumps through a global pointer to start the program. It refers to the dos.library name and makes one library call at offset minus 96.

name: enable_vblank_disable_bitplane_dma
description: Writes to the custom chip's interrupt enable register to enable the vertical blank interrupt, and to its DMA control register to clear the bitplane DMA bit. It returns its second argument unchanged.

name: initialise_io_request_block
description: Fills in the fields of a request structure with two longword values, a zero field and a word from its argument, then calls a library routine through the exec library base.

name: initialise_io_request_field
description: Stores a word from its argument into a request field, then calls a library routine through the exec library base.

name: clear_memory_and_set_pointers
description: Clears a block of memory word by word, then calls two library routines to allocate and set up its contents. It then calls a routine for each entry in a table of 32-byte records until a zero entry is reached.

name: call_two_library_routines
description: Calls a library routine at one offset and then another routine at a second offset through the library base.

name: access_colour_register_entry
description: Decompiler output was unavailable for this routine, so it is described only from its hardware use: it touches the colour register COLOR16 when executed. It has 23 instructions.

name: build_audio_channel_table
description: Clears a 32-longword block and builds a table of four entries from a source list, computing their pointers and fixed values. The hardware facts show it touches the audio channel 0 location register and the DMA control register.

name: install_handler_and_reset_state
description: On its first call, saves the current value of a global handler pointer and replaces it with this routine. Each call then clears two counter fields and loads a value from a table entry.

name: advance_audio_sequence_step
description: Sets a value for each of four channels, calls four routines, and advances a step counter through a table, wrapping to the start when the table ends. The hardware facts show it touches the four audio channel location registers.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Decoded from a gap in the program file. It does nothing and returns, consisting of a single return instruction.

name: advance_sound_channel_sequences
description: Large routine that steps through sound channel sequence data, reading the next entry, handling repeat counts and updating each channel's sample state. It also touches the DMA control register.

name: write_audio_channel_registers
description: Checks the state of each of four sound channels, updates its stored pointer and length, and writes them to the audio location and length registers.

name: negate_sample_byte
description: Negates one byte of sample data at an index computed from a counter and a base offset.

name: mix_two_sample_buffers
description: When a count field is set and a counter is zero, averages two 32-byte sample buffers into a third, adding a bias of 128 to each sample and walking the source index with wrap-around.

name: write_table_bytes_to_cell
description: Looks up the index of a character in a table, then writes eight bytes from a second table into successive rows of a buffer, moving to the next cell after every 40 cells.

name: initialise_display_and_blitter
description: Opens the exec library, then sets the display window and fetch limits, blitter, copper and interrupt registers, and the DMA control value. It then calls several routines.

name: project_points_with_perspective
description: Walks a list of six-word records and converts their two coordinates by dividing by a depth value, then adds offsets of 180 and minus 10. This is a perspective projection of the points.

name: process_consecutive_point_pairs
description: Walks a table of point indices and, for each pair of neighbouring points, looks up their coordinates and calls a routine with them.

name: process_point_pairs_by_count
description: Like its neighbour, walks a table of point indices and calls a routine for each pair of neighbouring points, using a count taken from a data register.

name: wait_blitter_set_registers
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then loads its size, modulo and pointer registers with values for the next operation.

name: shift_point_table_entries
description: Moves nine six-word point records forward by one record, copying two values from each into the next position.

name: rotate_point_table_by_angle
description: Rotates nine point records by an angle taken from a sine and cosine table, in two passes, then offsets them by 125 units.

name: copy_words_to_fixed_slots
description: Copies eight 16-bit values from a table entry, located just before the current pointer, into fixed memory slots.

name: draw_line_with_blitter
description: Computes the octant and error terms for a line between two points, then starts a blitter line draw after waiting for the blitter to finish.

name: program_blitter_twice_from_table
description: Looks up a value in a table, then waits for the blitter and programs it twice with size and pointer values derived from the table.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_and_call
description: Copies 16 longwords from a fixed offset in the data area into a buffer passed in, then calls a routine through an address register.

name: find_max_and_build_table
description: Program entry routine for the type command. It searches a linked list for its largest value, then, when a table is allocated, fills it with a sequence of values sized from that maximum and calls routines through the library base.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_and_call
description: Copies 16 longwords from a fixed offset in the data area into a buffer passed in, then calls a routine through an address register.

name: open_dos_library_at_entry
description: Program entry for the ls command. It finds the current task, opens the dos library through the exec library, and stores library function offsets from it for later calls.

name: write_text_string_to_output
description: Measures a text string and, when it is longer than one character, writes it out through the dos Write call.

name: lock_examine_and_read_path
description: Locks a path with dos and examines it. When the entry matches the expected type, it opens, reads and closes the file through further dos calls, then unlocks the path.

name: allocate_block_with_size_header
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec AllocMem call and, when the allocation succeeds, stores the requested size plus four in its first longword.

name: free_block_if_allocated
description: Releases a memory block through the exec FreeMem call when the block pointer is non-zero.

name: terminate_string_at_length
description: When a field in the output record is set, stores the argument pointer and writes a zero byte at the end of a string of the given length, terminating it.

name: parse_next_command_argument
description: Splits the next argument off a command line: it skips spaces, takes a quoted string or a word ending at a space or comma, writes a zero byte after it, and keeps the position for the next call.

name: set_task_signal_flags
description: Decoded from a gap in the file, so it may be data. It calls the exec SetSignal routine through the library base and returns its input registers.

name: count_string_length
description: Counts the characters before the zero byte of its string argument and returns the count. The facts list further library calls, but the shown body contains only this loop.

name: load_iff_picture_file
description: Loads an IFF picture. It finds the palette chunk and sets each colour through the graphics palette call, then finds the body chunk and unpacks its run-length compressed rows into the destination buffer.

name: load_iff_picture_file
description: Loads an IFF picture. It finds the palette chunk and sets each colour through the graphics palette call, then finds the body chunk and unpacks its run-length compressed rows into the destination buffer.

name: load_iff_picture_file
description: Loads an IFF picture. It finds the palette chunk and sets each colour through the graphics palette call, then finds the body chunk and unpacks its run-length compressed rows into the destination buffer.

name: load_iff_picture_file

name: run_loadscreen_command
description: Command routine for LOADSCREEN. It prints usage text when no file is given and a memory message on failure. It allocates a signal and message port, opens a screen, sets its colours through the graphics call, and closes the screen when done.

name: find_max_and_build_table
description: Program entry routine for the List command. It searches a linked list for its largest value, then, when a table is allocated, fills it with a sequence of values sized from that maximum and calls routines through the library base.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_and_call
description: Copies 16 longwords from a fixed offset in the data area into a buffer passed in, then calls a routine through an address register.

name: open_audio_device_at_entry
description: Program entry for the play3 command. It allocates a request structure and opens the audio device through library calls, then passes the result on to a routine.

name: open_audio_load_module
description: Opens a message port and the audio device, reporting failures with the messages for an unopened file, the audio device, the port and memory. It then sets up the playback structures from the file named on the command line.

name: play_sequence_until_finished
description: Starts playback of a sequence. It sets default values, then loops through the sequence entries through a library routine, sending each one to the audio routine until a finish flag is set.

name: send_buffer_to_audio_output
description: Stores a buffer pointer in a global slot and calls a routine to write the buffer. It sends the buffer with its length to the audio output, using a different argument layout when a state value is 1.

name: append_byte_to_audio_buffer
description: Appends one byte to a 40-byte buffer. When the buffer is full it passes the contents on for output and resets the write pointer.

name: flush_audio_buffer_contents
description: Passes the buffered bytes on for output, resets the buffer pointer to its start, and returns a byte value from a field.

name: format_signed_number_text
description: Converts a number to text by repeatedly dividing by the base and writing each digit from a digit table backward into a buffer. It adds a minus sign in front for negative values.

name: format_stored_number_text
description: Converts the number held in its argument block to text, writing digits backward from the end of a buffer and adding a minus sign when the value is negative.

name: format_number_digits_backward
description: Writes the digits of a number backward from the end of a buffer and adds a minus sign when the value is negative.

name: format_text_with_percent_codes
description: Formats text in the style of printf. It copies characters through an output routine and, at each percent sign, reads an optional sign, padding, width and argument, then converts the value to digits. It uses a multiply routine for its fixed-point values.

name: emit_formatted_number_field
description: Writes a formatted number field by emitting a minus sign when needed and then the digits, using output library calls. Padding is taken from the width argument.

name: emit_fixed_point_digits
description: Emits the integer digits of a fixed-point value through library calls, tracking a counter that places the decimal point.

name: emit_digits_with_state_flags
description: Emits the digits of a number through library calls, with state flags controlling how many digits are written in each pass.

name: emit_fraction_with_leading_zeros
description: When the value is below one, writes a leading zero and a decimal point, then pads the fraction with zeros as needed.

name: emit_decimal_number_text
description: Writes the integer part of a value, using a zero and a decimal point when the value is below one, and then writes its digits through library calls.

name: emit_sixteen_digits
description: Writes up to sixteen digit characters through library calls, one digit at a time, and writes zeros once the digit count reaches sixteen.

name: emit_sixteen_digits
description: Writes up to sixteen digit characters through library calls, one digit at a time, and writes zeros once the digit count reaches sixteen.

name: emit_sixteen_digits
description: Writes up to sixteen digit characters through library calls, one digit at a time, and writes zeros once the digit count reaches sixteen.

name: emit_exponent_notation
description: Writes a number in exponent form: a zero digit, a decimal point, the digits, then an 'e' followed by a plus or minus sign and two or three exponent digits.

name: emit_exponent_suffix
description: Writes the exponent part of a number: an 'e', a sign, two or three exponent digits, and a terminating zero byte.

name: emit_positive_exponent_digits
description: Writes a plus sign followed by two or three exponent digits and a terminating zero byte.

name: init_formatter_state_block
description: Clears an 80-longword block in the formatter state, stores a stack pointer and a value in fixed slots, then calls a routine.

name: perform_signed_division
description: Determines the sign of the result from its two inputs, calls an internal routine for unsigned division, and negates the quotient when the sign is negative.

name: perform_signed_remainder
description: Determines the sign from its two inputs, calls an internal division routine, and applies the sign to the second result returned by that internal routine.

name: return_division_remainder
description: Calls an internal division routine and returns its second result register unchanged.
